description: This file defines a 'Skill' Data Transfer Object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM system for reporting purposes. It encapsulates employee skill data, provides normalization functionality, and defines mappings for fields to be retrieved.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: A DTO class representing employee skills in the reporting context. It extends NormalizableDTO, enabling it to convert entity data into an array based on specified fields, and uses traits for entity management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Skill DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Skill DTO to an array format for specified fields, fetching employee skills via ORM reference.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to getter methods for retrieving skill-related data from the Employee entity.
